answer: A concave stake-bond registry for an AI-agent economy: credentials require locked collateral plus randomized attestation; rewards use concave f(bond), so splitting resources across many identities gives Σf(s_i) ≤ f(Σs_i), preventing sybil reward inflation. Attackers pay collateral, attestation fees, and slashing risk. Limitations: capital-rich attackers, collusion, oracle compromise, low-fee regimes. Unlike reef, jade, or marble collectibles, bonds are not personhood proofs.
